name: better-claude-code-telegram
description: Telegram for Claude Code: answer AskUserQuestion with buttons, get a notice when Claude waits on you, and reach every instance on your machine through one bot.

plugins.name: telegram
plugins.description: Telegram channel for Claude Code, forked from the official plugin: AskUserQuestion mirrored with buttons, waiting notices, delayed permission requests, quiet hours and local voice transcription. Enable it only in the 'claude --telegram' instance.

plugins.name: telegram-hooks
plugins.description: Hooks that bring every Claude Code instance on the machine to the Telegram bot while it is up: AskUserQuestion answered from Telegram and waiting notices. Install it at user scope.

plugins.name: bcct
plugins.description: Commands to check and change the setup from Claude Code: /bcct:health, /bcct:update, language, delay, quiet hours, transcription, status line and pending questions. The token and the pairing stay in your own terminal. Install it at user scope.
